title: fix: no-extraction fullscreen for stack tabs to prevent race condition

## Summary

Fixes #2146

When a tab inside a CosmicStack requests fullscreen, `remove_window()` triggered intermediate configures (via `set_tiled(false)`) that reached Firefox before the fullscreen configure. Firefox/GDK revokes fullscreen on any configure without the fullscreen state.
Fix: keep the tab in the stack (mirrors Sway/Hyprland). No extraction = no intermediate configures = no race condition.
Also removes `is_fullscreen` from `update_positions()` guard to prevent phantom slots.
Tested 30+ fullscreen/unfullscreen cycles with stacked Firefox tabs — deterministic.

Claude was used as a debugging partner for forensic log analysis, root cause identification, and code review. All code changes were written, understood, tested, and validated by me.
